claims.text: Nvidia's market value crossed $4 trillion on July 9, 2025, driven by sustained demand for its Blackwell accelerator rack systems (GB200/GB300), the ~$500 billion Stargate AI-infrastructure plan, and repeated upward revisions to capital expenditure guidance from major hyperscalers including Microsoft, Meta, Google, and Amazon throughout 2025 [Source: ev-1].

claims.text: This milestone indicates that the market is pricing AI infrastructure as the largest new capital cycle since the internet era, with Nvidia positioned as a central "toll-booth" in this spending supercycle [Source: ev-1].

The evidence outlines a rapid valuation trajectory where Nvidia reached $1 trillion in mid-2023, $2 trillion in February 2024, $3 trillion in June 2024, and finally $4 trillion in July 2025 following a significant price run-up in early July 2025 when its share price crossed approximately $160 [Source: ev-1].
